items.p: borrowed in fiscal 2025 for schools, roads, water mains and other projects. The buildings are not in the squares; the interest and principal are, as debt service.

items.p: owed at the end of fiscal 2025, about $14,100 per resident, most of it general obligation and Transitional Finance Authority bonds.

items.p: is the hole the Comptroller sees in fiscal 2028, growing to $8.5 billion by 2030. The current year balances, as the law requires; the next ones do not yet.

note: Also beside the budget: the Water Board, which bills for water and sewer service and pays the city for running the system; Health + Hospitals and the Housing Authority, which keep their own books and receive subsidies that do appear in the squares; and the MTA, a state authority.
